home.title: Simple role-based workflows for agriculture trade.
home.description: Choose a role to access dedicated login, registration, and dashboard flows for harvests, demands, assignments, and delivery updates.

farmer.label: Farmer
farmer.blurb: List harvest supply, track pricing, and manage availability.

retailer.label: Retailer
retailer.blurb: Post buying demand and monitor matching supply requests.

agent.label: Agent
agent.blurb: See assigned pickups and update delivery progress clearly.

admin.label: Admin
admin.blurb: Supervise supply, demand, matching, and delivery assignments.

auth.formCopy: Role is assigned automatically from this page.

error.wrongRole: This page is only for {{role}} accounts.
